title: Health Check Survey
description: This survey helps us understand your current health and wellness.

questions.question: Welcome Information
questions.content: Welcome! This survey will take about 3-5 minutes. We'll ask you some questions about how you're feeling today. You can answer naturally by typing, or use the interactive controls provided.

questions.question: How are you feeling today overall?
On a scale of 1-10, how much pain are you experiencing right now?
Please indicate on the body diagram where you feel the most discomfort.
Can you describe your symptoms in your own words?
How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?
How would you rate your energy level today?
Is there anything else you'd like us to know about your health today?
